text: Write 40 numbered lines, each one short sentence about lighthouses. Do not use any tools.

Without using any tools, reply in Markdown with exactly these parts in this order: a level 1 heading; a level 2 heading; a bulleted list of three items; a numbered list of three items; one sentence with a bold word, an italic word and an inline code span; a fenced Python code block of exactly three lines; a second level 2 heading; a table of two columns and three rows under its header row; one sentence with a link to https://example.com; a block quote; and one paragraph of more than 300 characters about lighthouses.
